metadata.scenario: A returning customer is concerned about the additional fees added to their monthly bill. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mary O'Connor. I'm calling because I have some concerns about my recent bill. Hi Mary, it's good to hear from you. What seems to be the issue with your bill? I noticed there are additional fees this month that I wasn't expecting, and it’s causing me a lot of anxiety. I understand, that can be quite concerning. Let me take a look at your account. Thank you, I appreciate it. I've been on IV antibiotic therapy for a while, so I want to make sure everything is clear. Absolutely, just a moment while I pull up your billing details... Alright, I see here that there are additional charges for the extra supplies used during your last few visits. Extra supplies? I wasn't aware that would be an additional fee. Yes, the IV administration requires certain materials that can vary based on your treatment needs. I see, but I thought those supplies were included in the service charge. I understand the confusion. Typically, we do include basic supplies, but specialized items can incur extra fees. That’s frustrating. I really didn’t expect this, especially since I’m already feeling anxious about the treatments. I completely understand, Mary. We strive to be as transparent as possible, and I apologize for any misunderstanding. Thank you for your understanding. Is there a way to review the specific charges together? Yes, absolutely! Would you like me to send you a detailed breakdown via email? Yes, that would be helpful. My email is mary.oconnor@email.com. Great, I’ll send that right away. Would you like to discuss any potential options for managing these charges? I’d appreciate that, yes. Maybe a care plan that could help lower the costs? We can schedule a care plan review with Lisa, our Care Coordinator. She can help tailor a plan to fit your needs. That sounds good. Can you set that up for me? Yes, I can do that. When are you available for a call with her? I’m free tomorrow afternoon if that works. Perfect, I’ll schedule it for 2 PM tomorrow and notify you with a confirmation. Thank you, Margaret. I feel a little better knowing I can talk to someone about this. You're welcome, Mary. It’s important to us that you feel comfortable and informed. I appreciate your help today. Thank you for calling, Mary. We’ll talk again soon! Bye. Goodbye!
